summary: Marex Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing the completion of a consent solicitation for its 6.404% Senior Notes due 2029. The company received requisite consents from holders of a majority of outstanding principal to amend the indenture, permitting a Bermuda (or other specified jurisdiction) holding company to assume the obligations under the notes. A Fourth Supplemental Indenture was entered into with Citibank, N.A. as trustee, effective immediately. No price, premium, or shareholder action was involved. This is a routine indenture amendment, not a special situation. What to watch: any subsequent re-domiciliation or holding company formation.
